title: Visit to the Kibalan Village of Sano Bay, North-East Coast of Formosa. Including a Vocabulary of the Dialect (Collingwood)
holder: Transactions of the Ethnological Society of London n.s. 6
evidence: 'Man (male), ma-roo-nah-nee / Woman, ta-roo-ang ... Knife, sa-rick' under heading 'Vocabulary of inhabitants of Sauo Bay'
novelty_basis: Not among Glottolog refs for Kavalan (30 refs; only Taintor 1875 of that era) or Basay; likely known to Formosanists (Tsuchida/Li) but not catalogued
notes: Early Kavalan data predating most published sources; includes loanwords (bras-co 'bottle').

title: Some Remarks on a Short Vocabulary of the Natives of Van Diemen Land; and also of the Menero Downs in Australia (Lhotsky)
holder: Journal of the Royal Geographical Society 9
evidence: Title and text: 'a short Vocabulary of the natives of Van Diemen Land' with Monaro words alongside
novelty_basis: Not in Glottolog refs for Ngarigu (4 refs) or Southeastern Tasmanian; cited in Australianist literature (Lhotsky known to Tasmanian/Monaro specialists)
notes: Monaro list is one of very few early Ngarigu sources.

title: On the Language and Inhabitants of Lord North's Island in the Indian Archipelago; with a Vocabulary (Pickering)
holder: Memoirs of the American Academy n.s. 2
size: vocabulary, several pages (from Horace Holden's captivity)
evidence: Title 'with a Vocabulary'; article by John Pickering
novelty_basis: Not among Glottolog's 9 Tobian refs; known in Micronesian/Holden literature
notes: Vocabulary text not fully reread; content attested by title/opening.
